question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution: The correct answer is '**Besides**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate title of the given passage is 'Nutrition in children'. • The most appropriate word for the third blank is '**Besides**'. • It means 'in addition to or as well as somebody/something; also.' (के अतिरिक्त, के साथ; भी) • *Example: There will be six people coming, **besides** you and Raj* • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Regardless**: paying no attention to somebody/something; treating problems and difficulties as unimportant. (किसी की परवाह न करते हुए; कठिनाइयों और समस्‍याओं को महत्वहीन या बेअसर मानते हुए) • **Against**: being an opponent to somebody/something in a game, competition, etc., or an enemy of somebody/something in a war or fight. [के विरुद्घ (खेल आदि में) या (युद्ध में) शत्रु] • **Instead**: in the place of somebody/something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के स्‍थान पर) **Correct Passage:__** *The most urgent areas of attention and immediate action are nutrition, health and education of children, whose well-being reflects the health of the society and caring outlook of the polity. Since the causes of malnutrition of children are many, like exploding population, bias against the female child, weak and suffering mothers, the remedy calls for ‘care of the mother and care by mother’, **besides**, an effective control over population explosion. Ignorance on what food should be taken is another (4)________ factor that results in malnutrition among women and children. The implementation of various schemes to fight the (5)________ of malnutrition and undernourishment of children requires planning, co-ordination and monitoring by high-powered bodies right down to the village level.* 45:Tcb6, The correct answer is '**contributory**'.
